CustomField.label: NF 36-month Value (display)
CustomField.description: 36 months of recurring charges plus one-time charges, as text.
CustomField.formula: "$" & IF((BLANKVALUE(NF_Monthly_Total__c, 0) * 36 + BLANKVALUE(NF_One_Time_Total__c, 0)) >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NF_Monthly_Total__c, 0) * 36 + BLANKVALUE(NF_One_Time_Total__c, 0)) / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(MOD(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NF_Monthly_Total__c, 0) * 36 + BLANKVALUE(NF_One_Time_Total__c, 0))), 1000)), 3), TEXT(FLOOR((BLANKVALUE(NF_Monthly_Total__c, 0) * 36 + BLANKVALUE(NF_One_Time_Total__c, 0))))) & "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD((BLANKVALUE(NF_Monthly_Total__c, 0) * 36 + BLANKVALUE(NF_One_Time_Total__c, 0)), 1) * 100, 0)), 2)
